tool_args.rationale: The monotone-concave pilot is consistent with the siphon base, but its narrow gradient range leaves parameter and branch ambiguity. The discriminating probe supplies the needed wide-gradient leverage.

considered_alternatives.option: Fit the smooth siphon model to the pilot alone
considered_alternatives.rejected_reason: The narrow s_grad range makes vmax and rho nearly collinear, so their separate effects are not reliably identifiable.
It costs more and does not specifically resolve the stated gradient-leverage ambiguity.
It is not relevant to identifying the siphon branch or gradient dependence.
